description: Header file defining the CurrencyDataLoader class and related enums, constants, and data structures for loading and managing currency data within the CalculatorApp project.

classes.name: CurrencyDataLoader
classes.description: Class responsible for loading, caching, and providing currency data and ratios, implementing data loader interfaces.

methods.name: CurrencyDataLoader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the data loader with optional override language.

methods.name: ~CurrencyDataLoader
methods.description: Destructor for cleanup.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Checks if data loading has finished.

methods.name: LoadedFromCache
methods.description: Checks if data was loaded from cache.

methods.name: LoadedFromWeb
methods.description: Checks if data was loaded from web.

methods.name: LoadData
methods.description: Initiates data loading process.

methods.name: GetOrderedCategories
methods.description: Returns categories of currency data.

methods.name: GetOrderedUnits
methods.description: Returns units within a category.

methods.name: LoadOrderedRatios
methods.description: Loads ratios for a given unit.

methods.name: SupportsCategory
methods.description: Checks if a category is supported.

methods.name: SetViewModelCallback
methods.description: Sets callback for view model updates.

methods.name: GetCurrencySymbols
methods.description: Retrieves symbols for two currency units.

methods.name: GetCurrencyRatioEquality
methods.description: Gets ratio equality for two units.

methods.name: GetCurrencyTimestamp
methods.description: Returns timestamp of currency data.

methods.name: RoundCurrencyRatio
methods.description: Static method to round currency ratios.

methods.name: TryLoadDataFromCacheAsync
methods.description: Attempts to load data from cache asynchronously.

methods.name: TryLoadDataFromWebAsync
methods.description: Attempts to load data from web asynchronously.

methods.name: TryLoadDataFromWebOverrideAsync
methods.description: Overrides web data load asynchronously.

methods.name: OnNetworkBehaviorChanged
methods.description: Handles network behavior changes.

methods.name: ResetLoadStatus
methods.description: Resets the load status state.

methods.name: NotifyDataLoadFinished
methods.description: Notifies that data load has finished.

methods.name: TryFinishLoadFromCacheAsync
methods.description: Completes cache load process asynchronously.

methods.name: TryParseWebResponses
methods.description: Parses web response JSON data.

methods.name: TryParseStaticData
methods.description: Parses static currency data JSON.

methods.name: TryParseAllRatiosData
methods.description: Parses ratios data JSON.

methods.name: FinalizeUnits
methods.description: Finalizes unit setup after data load.

methods.name: GuaranteeSelectedUnits
methods.description: Ensures selected units are valid.

methods.name: SaveLangCodeAndTimestamp
methods.description: Saves language code and timestamp info.

methods.name: UpdateDisplayedTimestamp
methods.description: Updates timestamp display.

methods.name: RegisterForNetworkBehaviorChanges
methods.description: Registers for network change events.

methods.name: UnregisterForNetworkBehaviorChanges
methods.description: Unregisters network change events.

methods.name: GetDefaultFromToCurrency
methods.description: Gets default currency pair.

methods.name: TryGetLastUsedCurrenciesFromLocalSettings
methods.description: Retrieves last used currencies from local settings.

methods.name: SaveSelectedUnitsToLocalSettings
methods.description: Saves selected units to local settings.
